## Objective
Replace the stub bodies in `src/logic.js` with a pure, immutable implementation so the tests in T1 pass.

## Interface
Keep the exported signatures and typedefs in `src/logic.js` exactly: `createState(width,height,rng?)`, `turn(state,dir)`, `tick(state,rng?)`, `placeFood(snake,width,height,rng?)`. `rng` defaults to `Math.random`.

## Behavior
1. createState: 3-cell snake centred, heading right, score 0, status 'running', food from placeFood.
2. turn returns a new state with nextDirection set unless dir is the opposite of `direction`.
3. tick returns a new state: direction = nextDirection, head advances one cell; if status is not 'running' returns the same state.
4. Out-of-grid head or head on a body cell (excluding the tail cell when not growing) gives status 'over' with the snake unchanged.
5. Head on food: snake grows, score += 10, new food via placeFood; if none is free, status 'won'.
6. placeFood picks uniformly among free cells via rng, null if none.

## Invariants
No input mutation, no DOM or browser APIs (must run under node), no dependencies.

## Edge cases
Growth tick keeps the tail; non-growth tick vacates it. Grid fully filled.

## Guardrails
Do not modify tests. Do not change exports.

## Out of scope
Rendering, keyboard handling, timers.
